claim: QA round 4 H4, 2026-11-07: a firing key (ADR 0191 round 3, fire:day|week|month) is read on the house's clock. suppression.ts onHouseClock(at, zone) turns the instant into the house's calendar day with common/house-day.ts houseToday(zone, at), and returns the instant unchanged when there is no zone (UTC, the one clock such a house has); withFiring(target, period, instant, zone) keys firingGrain(period, onHouseClock(instant, zone)). RecommendationsService reads the zone with readHouseZone before keying each rule (withFiring gets firingZone), and InsightGeneratorService.generate re-keys every fire: grain that record() produced with firingGrain("week", onHouseClock(firedAt, firingZone)). A zone READ failure falls back to UTC and is said: both answer suppressionsReadable false (ADR 0020), since a card dismissed under the house-day key may show again. Read with // and /* */ comments stripped. Exit 0 here; exit 1 on origin/main 259feea3f. Not checked here: run-time behaviour (recommendation-round3.spec.ts, 'a firing is read on the house's clock'); dismissals written under a UTC key before this change, which can differ from the house-day key once, on deploy day.

QA round 10b, 2026-11-07 (#826): InsightGeneratorService.generate, right after it re-keys a fire: grain with i.periodKey = firingGrain("week", onHouseClock(firedAt, firingZone)), rebuilds i.suppression (key with buildSuppressionKey(target, "insight"), keys with suppressionKeys(target)) from a target whose periodKey is the re-keyed i.periodKey. Before it, record() built the suppression on the UTC week and nothing refreshed it, so a weekly insight dismissed from the catalogue (rec-catalog.ts reads suppression.key) in the hours the house week and the UTC week differ came straight back. Read with comments stripped. Exit 0 here; exit 1 at 0ceab6a0d. Not checked here: run-time behaviour (recommendation-round3.spec.ts, 'the generator re-keys its weekly firings on the house's clock').
